Read Chapter 5 sections 5.1–5.11 for graph basics, trees, connectivity, coloring and planar graphs; read Chapter 4 for SDR/matchings.
Read Chapter 6 Flows for network flow theory.
Watch/read the 29 spectral graph theory lectures for adjacency/Laplacian eigenvalues, random walks and Cheeger constants.
